prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE individual square detailed painterly naturalistic illustration of the Icelandic tilberi or snakkur, a witch-created milk-stealing creature made from a human rib wrapped in stolen GREY WOOL. Depict the established material form as a small animated elongated curved rib-shaped object completely sheathed in matted grey wool; a flexible wormlike narrow body, without limbs, without invented human face, wings or horns. It curls and stretches along the sill of a shadowy old Icelandic dairy window beside a wooden milk churn and a small milk spill. The wool winding must remain clearly recognizable, not naked flesh and not a cute furry animal. Tight close view at creature level, entire elongated silhouette visible with margins. Cold moonlight and dim dairy lamplight, unsettling furtive supernatural atmosphere suggesting a malicious milk thief, no gore, no victims, no witch present. Avoid giant skeleton, exposed human bone, dragon, caterpillar legs or charming mascot styling. No text, letters, runes, borders or watermark. Contemporary artistic interpretation based on the documented wool-wrapped rib form.
visual_requirements: Small rib-derived elongated creature wrapped in grey wool
Flexible stretched form appropriate to milk thief
Sinister uncanny atmosphere without violent anatomy
depicted_variant: A small elongated wool-wrapped rib-shaped magical milk thief at the dairy window beside a wooden churn.
aura: Uncanny furtive malicious household magic, small but disturbing.
